title: NXS suite declaration (suite.yaml)
description: The declared rig as a graph of blocks: nodes of a type with their parameters, and the connections keyed by the source port. A node's type resolves to a description, which fixes its kind, its ports and the rows its parameters name (`nxs describe <type>`). Shape only: the rows each block offers, the values each takes, the ports' types and attributes, one source per input and the laws across nodes are checked by the loader and by `nxs status`, and `nxs tune --schema` narrows this schema by the blocks on the rig.

api.description: The declaration language this nxs reads. A file of api 2, or one without it in the 1.0 form of ports and units, is written in api 3 by `nxs generate`.

nodes.description: The rig's nodes by name: at most one host, the hubs, the units, the cameras, the clicks and the modules.

connections.description: A source port, <node>.<port>, and the ports it feeds.

port_ref.description: A port: the node's name, a dot, the port's name (links.A, csi.B, out, bus_cam0, can0).

type.description: The node's type: a host plugin (jetson), a hub's deserializer compatible, a unit module (nxs, nxs-module), a cam personality's compatible or a click personality.

parameters.description: Rows of the block by name, each value in the row's display form, and the identity pins it takes (address, serial, firmware).
